tasks.title: Add environment variable validation
tasks.description: Implement validation function to check that required environment variables (NOTION_API_KEY, NOTION_DATABASE_ID) are present and non-empty before any API operations. Should throw clear error messages indicating which variables are missing.

validation_rules: NOTION_API_KEY must be defined and non-empty
NOTION_DATABASE_ID must be defined and non-empty
Should be called at module initialization

acceptance_criteria: Function throws descriptive error if NOTION_API_KEY is missing
Function throws descriptive error if NOTION_DATABASE_ID is missing
Validation occurs before any Notion API calls
Error messages clearly indicate which variable is missing

tasks.title: Improve error handling with custom error classes
tasks.description: Create custom error classes (NotionConfigError, NotionAPIError) to distinguish between configuration issues and API failures. Update all try-catch blocks to use these errors and provide actionable error messages.

technical_details.error_handling_strategy: Wrap API errors with context, preserve stack traces

acceptance_criteria: Custom error classes extend Error properly
All API errors are wrapped in NotionAPIError

tasks.title: Implement getTask function to retrieve individual tasks
tasks.description: Create a function to retrieve a single task by its Notion page ID. Should return the task properties in a structured format or throw an error if the task doesn't exist.
acceptance_criteria: Function accepts page ID as parameter
Returns task properties (title, status, notes, assignee)
Uses custom error handling from TASK-002

tasks.title: Implement listTasks function with filtering
tasks.description: Create a function to query the Notion database and retrieve multiple tasks. Should support optional filtering by status and assignee. Implement pagination handling for large result sets.
acceptance_criteria: Returns empty array if no tasks match

tasks.title: Implement deleteTask function
tasks.description: Create a function to archive (soft delete) a task in Notion. Notion doesn't support hard deletion via API, so this should set the archived property to true.
acceptance_criteria: Function accepts page ID as parameter

tasks.title: Extend updateTask to support all properties
tasks.description: Enhance the existing updateTask function to support updating title, assignee, status, and notes. Make all parameters optional except pageId, only updating properties that are provided.

technical_details.update_strategy: Build properties object dynamically based on provided parameters

acceptance_criteria: Can update multiple properties in single call

tasks.title: Refactor to prevent auto-execution on import
tasks.description: Move the main() function call to a conditional that only executes when the file is run directly, not when imported as a module. Use ES modules pattern with import.meta.url checking.

technical_details.alternative_approach: Move main() to separate CLI file

acceptance_criteria: main() does not execute when file is imported
main() executes when file is run directly with node
No breaking changes to existing functionality

tasks.title: Create comprehensive unit tests
tasks.description: Set up testing framework (Jest or Mocha) and create unit tests for all functions. Mock Notion API calls to test logic without requiring actual API access. Aim for >80% code coverage.

tasks.title: Create .env.example file
tasks.description: Create a template .env.example file documenting all required environment variables with descriptive comments and placeholder values. This helps users understand configuration requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Comments explain how to obtain each value

tasks.title: Expand README with comprehensive documentation
tasks.description: Rewrite README.md to include: project overview, features list, prerequisites, installation steps, configuration instructions, usage examples for all functions, API reference, troubleshooting section, and contribution guidelines.
acceptance_criteria: Installation steps are clear and complete
Usage examples provided for each function
Code examples use proper syntax highlighting

tasks.title: Add JSDoc comments to all functions
tasks.description: Add comprehensive JSDoc documentation to all functions including parameter types, return types, descriptions, examples, and error conditions. This enables better IDE autocomplete and generated documentation.
acceptance_criteria: All exported functions have JSDoc comments
At least one usage example per function

tasks.title: Add input validation to all functions
tasks.description: Implement parameter validation for all functions to check types, required fields, and value constraints before making API calls. Throw clear validation errors for invalid inputs.

validation_requirements.title: Must be non-empty string when provided

acceptance_criteria: Validation errors are thrown before API calls

tasks.title: Create integration tests with Notion API
tasks.description: Create integration tests that run against a real Notion test database (optional, skipped if credentials not available). Tests should verify actual API interactions and end-to-end workflows.

test_requirements: Tests should be skippable if no credentials

acceptance_criteria: Integration tests can run against real API
Tests are skipped gracefully if no credentials
Test data cleaned up after run
Separate npm script for integration tests

tasks.title: Add TypeScript type definitions
tasks.description: Create TypeScript declaration file (index.d.ts) to provide type definitions for all exported functions. This improves developer experience for TypeScript users without converting the entire project.
acceptance_criteria: All exported functions have type definitions

tasks.title: Add CLI interface (optional enhancement)
tasks.description: Create a command-line interface wrapper allowing the tool to be used directly from terminal with commands like 'notion-task create', 'notion-task list', etc. Use a CLI framework like Commander.js.

technical_details.package_json_updates: Add bin field for global installation

acceptance_criteria: Help text available for all commands
Can be installed globally with npm install -g

Build out complete CRUD functionality with proper validation
